Pest & termite resistant: Coconut fibre is naturally resistant to insects, eliminating infestation risk in warehouses and during ocean transit.
No synthetic waste: Coir panels do not fragment or shed. Recyclable as non-hazardous industrial waste at end of life.
Fully customisable: We engineer each box to your product dimensions. No standard-size compromises.
